meta.name: US-listed large caps
meta.rankingPolicy: Verified dated month-end company caps in USD, screened from the public US-listed directory; one issuer per SEC CIK.
meta.deduplication: One full company cap per SEC CIK; share-class caps are never summed. Canonical IDs are retained on refresh.
meta.membershipBasis: Current screened top 1000 applied to all months; not historical membership. Survivorship bias.
meta.currencyPolicy: US-listing cap series are USD. Conflicting financial-currency API metadata is overridden only after matching dated values against the public USD market-cap page (minimum one exact-date overlap; median error <=2%). Raw metadata and validation evidence are retained. No FX conversion is applied to already-USD caps.
